verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes MoonPay as a hosted service ('MoonPay runs the KYC, payments, and UI'). The clone-able demo integrations and SDKs are client-side building blocks that call MoonPay's rails; they are not a self-hostable core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
